race.comment: IN'KANTOSSTAR (8) is clearly the one to beat and the early betting reflects that. Two starts this time in have resulted in two very soft wins, sent out $1.24 first up and doing it easily before beating Yauson at Geelong who was heavily backed and bolted in next start. Up to 1500m looks ideal and he draws perfectly - only bad luck beats him and other connections agree with a few scratchings shortening the price even further. KATSUMI OROCHI (9) was okay first up behind IN'KANTOSSTAR and can improve on drier ground but has a bit to make up. THE BENCHMARK (11) struggled last time but is in the minor mix while ANGLAND (3) would be a hope on best but is struggling for form.
